# Waleed Albadawi

> Enterprise technology and transformation executive who reshapes banks into future-ready institutions. VP, Enterprise Integration (Head of Integration) at a Saudi bank in Riyadh, with 14+ years in enterprise technology, most of them in Saudi banking and government. Recognized as a Tech100 Strategic Leader of the Future (Saudi Arabia Edition). Also known as Walid Albadawi, Waleed Al-Badawi.

Waleed Albadawi leads enterprise integration, platform strategy, regulatory connectivity and AI readiness in regulated banking. His work moves institutions from projects to platforms, from vendor dependency to owned capability, from reactive compliance to real-time regulatory connectivity, and from AI experiments to governed, AI-ready foundations. In 2026 the function he leads put 129 integration services (89 new), 392 production releases, 49 new API products and four flagship programmes into production.

Beyond integration, he shapes strategic technology reviews (core banking modernisation, treasury, corporate internet banking, payments, Open Banking), managed-services sourcing and governance, technology spend, and the resilience of critical services, and he founded the bank's Digital Factory.

## Signature programmes

- [Integration-as-a-Platform Strategy](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#integration-platform-strategy): integration repositioned from cost centre to the bank's operating backbone across 50+ systems.
- [Cloud-Native Banking Platform](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#cloud-native-banking-platform): containerised microservices, zero-trust service mesh, critical services active-active across sites.
- [Automated Integration Delivery Platform](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#automated-integration-delivery): CI/CD and GitOps on IBM Cloud Pak for Integration for 12 integration platforms on 142 repositories.
- [Enterprise Integration Framework & Standards](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#integration-framework): ten standards and four review gates that every project and vendor builds to.
- [AI-Native Readiness & Claude-Native Engineering](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#ai-native-readiness): governed foundations so AI can be adopted safely in a regulated bank.
- [Regulatory Connectivity Programme](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#regulatory-connectivity): national enforcement, credit-bureau and central-bank reporting across 12+ programmes.
- [Open Banking, Built In-House](https://www.wbadawi.info/projects.html#open-banking): 130/130 SAMA functional conformance tests passed in sandbox; FAPI 2.0 security profile.

## Topics

Enterprise integration strategy; integration platform modernisation; IBM Cloud Pak for Integration; API strategy and API economy; Open Banking (SAMA, FAPI 2.0); real-time payments (IPS, SARIE, SADAD); event-driven architecture; GitOps and platform engineering; integration governance and standards; AI readiness and AI governance in banking; regulatory technology; digital transformation in Saudi Arabia and Vision 2030.
